bots.name: Statements scout
bots.does: Collects results and statements and the fundamental scores built from them.
bots.detail: Fundamental scores for 1998 stocks (value, quality, fundamental momentum, distress band) from the nightly ALADIN fundamentals job; company profiles for 2843 stocks on the site.

bots.name: Ownership scout
bots.does: Promoter and public shareholding each quarter; takeover-code (SAST Reg 29) acquisitions and sales by large holders and promoters.
bots.detail: Shareholding history for 499 of 500 stocks (20 refreshed this run, each at most weekly); 1387 takeover-code (SAST Reg 29) disclosures kept, to 2026-11-16. Insider (PIT) trades: not measured (NSE's feed returns no recent rows).

bots.name: Governance scout
bots.does: Collects governance announcements: auditors, ratings, delayed results, insolvency, pledges, related-party deals, litigation, regulator actions.
bots.wraps: also reports the tone reading of scripts/aladin_filings.py
bots.detail: 873 governance announcements kept (auditors, ratings, delayed results, insolvency, pledges and encumbrances, related-party, litigation, regulator actions), newest 2026-11-15. Also: the existing filings job's tone reading for 468 stocks.

bots.name: Related-party scout
bots.does: Related-party deals, group companies and who depends on whom, from the companies' own filings.
bots.detail: NEXUS supply graph: 1,416 links among 1,046 companies from their own filings; revenue profiles for 950; 32 business groups. The graph is saved only when its audit passes, so its date shows when it last passed.

bots.name: Blind-spot analyst
bots.does: Nine red-flag tests on ownership, governance and the annual statements, each finding citing its filing.
bots.detail: Red-flag rules R1-R9 (declared before scoring) on 500 stocks; statements available for 0. R4 rating downgrades and R7 pledges: not measured (NSE's summaries do not say which way; the PDFs do). promoter stake down: 78, auditor resigned: 2, promoter selling: 1, insolvency: 1

bots.name: India scout
bots.does: RBI (repo, liquidity, credit, reserves) and MOSPI (CPI, IIP, GDP).
bots.detail: Arrives in step 4 of the plan.

bots.name: Global scout
bots.does: US and global rates, inflation, dollar, and India series, from FRED and the World Bank.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 4 of the plan.

bots.name: Market-macro scout
bots.does: Crude, gold, USD/INR and the US 10-year yield, daily.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 4 of the plan.

bots.name: Macro analyst
bots.does: Today's macro state and its tested outcome for the NIFTY 500, sectors and strategies.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 4 of the plan.

bots.name: India media scraper
bots.does: Indian business media headlines.
sources: Economic Times, Mint, Business Standard RSS
bots.detail: 234 headlines from 13 feeds (Economic Times · Markets, Business Standard · Markets, Mint · Markets, CNBC…) by the existing news wire.

bots.name: Global & macro scraper
bots.does: World events and news around shipping and oil chokepoints.
bots.detail: 0 world events (GDELT) and news around 7 shipping and oil chokepoints; 10 regions scored for news attention.

bots.name: Sector scraper
bots.does: Industry and regulator news per sector.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 5 of the plan.

bots.name: Social scraper
bots.does: Retail chatter, only where the source's terms allow.
bots.detail: Retail chatter: 0 posts matched to stocks in the latest window, read by the existing sentiment job only when Reddit is reachable. Its terms need approval for commercial use; kept as it is until the owner decides (plan, section 7).

bots.name: Headline scorer
bots.does: Scores the tone of headlines that name a stock (FinBERT, news only).
bots.detail: FinBERT tone of headlines for 52 stocks (existing sentiment job, news part only). Rule: a finding when at least 2 headlines name the stock and their average tone is beyond ±0.25; 5 this run.

bots.name: News analyst (AI)
bots.does: Reads the day's key news: event, who is named, and which stocks are exposed without being named.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 5 of the plan.

bots.name: Event historian
bots.does: Which stocks moved after similar events in the past.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 5 of the plan.

bots.name: Price scout
bots.does: End-of-day prices, volume and every NSE index.
bots.detail: End-of-day prices for 2983 of 3005 main-board stocks (session 2026-11-13); NIFTY 500 to 2026-11-13.

bots.name: Flows scout
bots.does: FII/DII flows; bulk and block deals and F&O open interest from step 3.
bots.detail: FII/DII cash-market flows for 34 sessions to 2026-11-13 (FII net Rs 5,737 Cr, DII net Rs -2,254 Cr). Bulk and block deals and F&O open interest arrive in step 3.

bots.name: Regime bot
bots.does: Today's market state: trend, volatility, breadth.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 3 of the plan.

bots.name: Strategy lab
bots.does: A fixed library of strategies tested in every past market state.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 3 of the plan.

bots.name: Analog finder
bots.does: The past periods most like today and what came next.
bots.detail: Arrives in step 3 of the plan.
